Scientists may have found a way to keep aging muscles strong. We’d still like you to go lift something.

Stanford’s Helen Blau discovered an enzyme called 15-PGDH that builds up in our bodies as we age. Blocking it restored muscle strength and regrew knee cartilage in mice. Now a company called Epirium Bio is working to turn it into a pill for sarcopenia, and early human safety trials are already underway.
